parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. Looking at my resources, I have 3 Wood and 2 Wheat. My Wheat 9 is currently blocked by Claude's robber, making Wheat production slower than it should be. Gemma also has 3 Wood and only 1 Wheat. She claims she wants to help me because I 'lack Wood', but I actually have 3 Wood already. Wheat is much more valuable to me right now than more Wood, especially since Brick is the real bottleneck for everyone. Accepting this trade would give Gemma Wheat she needs while giving me a resource I already have in surplus. I'll reject and keep my Wheat for a potential city or settlement when I get Brick.
parsed.note_to_self: Gemma tried to trade Wood for Wheat, claiming I need Wood. I have 3 Wood and 2 Wheat (with Wheat 9 blocked). Keeping the Wheat is better for my Monopoly strategy or for future building.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'מה, יש לי כבר מספיק עץ בידיים, אבל החיטה שלי יקרה לי מדי כרגע, במיוחד כשקלוד חוסם לי את ה-9. אני אאלץ לוותר.
